The '''Ueda system''' was a [[star system]] in the [[Unincorporated Bosphian provinces]], an informal [[sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="AcolyteVG" /> and the [[New Territories]]<ref name="New Territories" /> during the [[High Republic Era]], a [[time]] when most of the Outer Rim was independent of representation in the [[Galactic Republic]]. The system was located in [[Standard Galactic Grid]] square Q-3 and contained the [[planet]] [[Ueda]] and its satellites, the [[moon]] [[Uedar]] and an [[Ueda orbital station|orbital station]].<ref name="AcolyteVG" /> By the time of the [[Galactic Empire]], the system had become part of the [[Xappyh sector]].<ref name="Appendix" />

Ueda was at one point the site of lucrative [[Wood|logging]] and milling operations, with [[Pirate|marauders]] striking at the world for its processed materials.<ref name="AcolyteVG" /> By [[132 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TheAcolyteDate}}</ref> Ueda had become a signatory into the Republic within the last eighty [[Standard year|years]] and the operations had ceased.<ref name="AcolyteVG" /> In that year,<ref name="Date" /> the [[Sith assassin]] [[Mae-ho Aniseya]] [[Mae's quest|traveled]] to Ueda and [[Indara's murder|murdered]] the [[Jedi Master]] [[Indara]]<ref name="LostFound">{{Acolyte|Lost / Found}}</ref> in [[Point Ueda]].<ref name="AcolyteVG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Ueda system appeared in "[[Lost / Found]],"<ref name="LostFound" /> the first episode of the live-action television series ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'', which aired on [[Disney+]] on [[June 4]], [[2024]].<ref name="Announcement">{{SW|url=news/the-acolyte-teaser-poster|text=''The Acolyte'' Teaser Poster, Premiere Date Revealed}}</ref> The system was then identified in the [[2025]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="AcolyteVG" />
